faq: Which website platforms do you support?

WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Shopify and custom sites all work. If your platform lets us add a small script or widget, we can place the feature. Tell us the platform in the form and we confirm fit before we start.
Who pays for the AI usage?
You do, directly to the AI provider, through your own account. We set usage limits so it stays predictable. Our price covers the build only, and we show you the typical cost per thousand questions.
We aim to reduce this by limiting answers to your content and adding a fallback such as please contact us when it is unsure. No AI tool is perfect, so we test it on sample questions before launch.
Can I edit what it says later?

Yes. Answers come from your site content and a short instructions file. Update your pages and the assistant picks up the change after a refresh, and we show you how to edit the tone and rules yourself.
desc:
Add AI to your website without rebuilding it: a chat assistant that answers from your pages, a smarter search box or a writing helper for your team. Ecom Swift LLC connects it to your content, matches your design and gives you a private test link before anything goes live.

## What does it mean to add AI to your website?

It means placing a small, focused feature on your existing pages that uses an AI model and your own content. Visitors might ask a question in a chat box and receive an answer written from your service pages. Staff might use a helper that drafts text in your style. A search box might understand full sentences rather than only exact keywords.

The site itself stays as it is. The feature is added on top, and it can be switched off without changing the rest of your pages.

## Why a generic chatbot is not enough

Many plug-in widgets answer from general knowledge. They can drift off topic, invent details about your business or recommend things you do not offer. Visitors cannot tell the difference between a made-up answer and a real one, so one wrong reply reflects on your brand.

A feature that is tied to your own pages, limited to relevant topics and given a safe fallback reply behaves differently. When it does not know, it says so and points to your contact page.

## How it affects visitors and leads

Most visitors leave a website without ever asking their question. An assistant that responds at once lowers the effort of finding information, which can mean more enquiries, fewer repeated emails and a clearer path to your contact form. Lead capture lets interested visitors leave their details in the same conversation.

Results depend on how complete your pages are. If an answer is not on your site, the assistant cannot find it, so we report content gaps that you can fill.

## What a good website set-up includes

- Your chosen pages read in as the source of answers.
- A chat window, search box or writing helper styled to match your brand.
- Topic limits that keep replies relevant to your business.
- A fallback reply and a handoff to your contact form when it cannot answer.
- Layouts that work on desktop and mobile.
- A simple on and off switch you control.
- A chat log or usage view, so you can read what visitors ask.
- Lead capture sent to your email, where you want it.
- A test round using sample questions before launch.
- A short team guide for updating content and settings.

## What we do

We start by agreeing which feature fits your goals. We read your pages, set up the assistant or helper and match your fonts and colors. You receive a private test link first, and you can try questions and ask for changes. After you approve, we publish it to the live site.

The Basic package adds one feature trained on a limited set of pages. The Standard package adds a second feature, more pages, topic limits and a chat or usage view. The Premium package covers up to three features, lead capture, handoff to your form, a usage dashboard and a recorded walkthrough. We work with most common site platforms and tell you early if yours has limits.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Make sure your pages state prices, hours and policies clearly.
- Pick one clear job for the first feature.
- Read the chat log weekly and fix gaps in your content.
- Give the assistant a name and a short, honest introduction.
- Keep a contact route to a real person visible.

**Avoid:**
- Letting it answer medical, legal or financial questions it cannot support.
- Indexing pages that are out of date.
- Hiding the fact that visitors are talking to software.
- Covering the page with a large pop-up on every visit.
- Forgetting to update the pages the assistant reads after launch.

## Who it is for

A service business wants visitors to get quick answers about what it offers. A publisher wants a search box that finds articles by question. A small team wants a writing helper on its content pages, kept private to staff.

## What we need from you

We need the address of your site, the pages the feature should read and access as a collaborator, staff or developer user where your platform supports it. Never send passwords. The AI provider is billed in your own account, and we explain usage settings so costs stay predictable. You approve the private test link before we publish.
